description: Call when listing APIs or inspecting one API before scaffolding a test. For a single API, prefer api_card. For new tests, prefer scaffold_test once apiPath is known. selectedApi omits full file content unless includeContent is true. Do not use testlight, npx, npm, shell, or node dist/mcp/server.js.

apiPath.description: Optional API .mmt file path relative to workspaceRoot

includeContent.description: Include full API file content (default false)
